mariadb modeling -e 'CREATE TABLE customers (id INT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(20), email VARCHAR(40)); INSERT INTO customers VALUES (1,"kim","kim@example.com"),(2,"lee","lee@example.com"),(3,"park","park@example.com")'

# 엔티티 = 테이블, 속성 = 열, id 가 PK
answers.7:
mariadb modeling -e 'CREATE TABLE orders (id INT PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INT, item VARCHAR(30), FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers(id)); INSERT INTO orders VALUES (1,1,"pen"),(2,1,"book"),(3,2,"desk")'

# N 쪽(orders)에 FK. 부모(customers)가 먼저 있어야 만들 수 있다
answers.8:
mariadb -N modeling -e 'SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.id) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name' > /tmp/count.txt
cat /tmp/count.txt

# 1:N 은 FK 로 JOIN 한다. 주문 없는 고객도 보려면 LEFT JOIN, COUNT 는 o.id 로 센다
answers.10:
mariadb modeling -e 'CREATE TABLE enrollments (student_id INT, course_id INT, PRIMARY KEY (student_id, course_id), FOREIGN KEY (student_id) REFERENCES students(id), FOREIGN KEY (course_id) REFERENCES courses(id)); INSERT INTO enrollments VALUES (1,1),(1,2),(2,1)'

# N:M = 연결 테이블 + 외래 키 둘. 두 열 묶음 PK 로 같은 짝 중복을 막는다
answers.11:
mariadb -N modeling -e 'SELECT s.name, c.title FROM enrollments e JOIN students s ON e.student_id = s.id JOIN courses c ON e.course_id = c.id' > /tmp/enroll.txt
cat /tmp/enroll.txt

# N:M 조회 = 연결 테이블에서 양쪽 테이블로 JOIN 두 번
